manifest.name: @daweifu/capability-menu
manifest.description: Unified capability management for the DeepSeek Harness: catalog (ctx.capability) + meta_search/meta_invoke + Resident/On-demand/Disabled projection policy + 能力菜单 settings tab, in one installable bundle (server + browser).

bundle.text:
# dsh-capability-menu aggregate bundle patch: mounts the meta plugins in one
# layer, from a single installable package.
#
# One package, five plugin entries — four mount a subpath of
# `@daweifu/capability-menu` (the loader resolves package subpath exports; see
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/startup` for the same pattern in the harness), and
# the root entry loads the package main to mount the browser-facing gateway
# (and thereby registers the package itself as a `dsh.client` loader entry):
#
#   - id: capability-menu-registry
#     name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/registry'
#   - id: capability-menu-search
#     name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/search'
#   - id: capability-menu-invoke
#     name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/invoke'
#   - id: capability-menu-policy
#     name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/policy'
#       config:
#         # Rule syntax — tier keys `resident` / `on-demand` / `disabled`
#         # (exact names, `*` globs, or `server:<name>:*`), plus `metaTools` —
#         # and the priority order are documented in the README「配置」
#         # section; the shipped defaults live in the insert block below.
#
# - `capability-menu-registry` (P0): builds/indexes the capability catalog and
#   exposes the `ctx.capability` service (search/get/getDetail/refresh). It registers
#   no model-facing tool itself. Indexes every visible tool — MCP tools by their
#   server and harness-native tools (bash/read/write/…) under the reserved
#   `built-in` pseudo-server — plus skills from the global layer and every
#   mountable preset's standing scope. `meta_search` searches this live index.
# - `capability-menu-search` (P1): registers the `meta_search` tool (list + detail).
# - `capability-menu-invoke` (P2): registers the `meta_invoke` tool (unified
#   execution of tools — MCP or native — and skill loading). Executes in the
#   caller's agent view so On-demand tools stay runnable without bypassing scope
#   restrictions; dedups already-loaded skills. Rejects Disabled capabilities.
# - `capability-menu-policy` (P3): Resident/On-demand/Disabled projection
#   strategy + 能力菜单 surface. Reads explicit resident/on-demand/disabled
#   rules (exact name + glob + server:<name>:*) and filters each step's tool
#   admission on DSH 0.2.2; older hosts use `assembly.tools`. Web guidance
#   sections are filtered at `system-prompt/assemble`. On-demand capabilities remain executable
#   via `meta_invoke`. Exposes `ctx.capabilityPolicy` to the 能力菜单 tab through
#   the Typert gateway: the tier surface (`classifyAll`/`getConfig`/
#   `updateConfig`), the registered-location surface (`listLocations`/`addLocation`/
#   `updateLocation`/`removeLocation` and `listSkillLocations`/`addSkillLocation`/
#   `updateSkillLocation`/`removeSkillLocation`/`adoptSkillLocation`), the
#   read-only rules and search summaries (`getCatalogDocs`), a rebuild trigger (`refresh`), and
#   skill browsing (`getDetail`/`listSkillDir`/`readSkillFile`). Tier clicks land
#   in the plugin's state file after `persistDebounceMs`; search settings share
#   that file. Registered MCP servers land in `patchFile`, and skill directories
#   live under `skillsDir`.
#
# Default (policy present but no config): every capability is Resident — the
# `classify` fallback, nothing is hidden. Add explicit `on-demand`/`disabled`
# rules to pull capabilities out of the model surface.
# The web surface disables the host skill filesystem provider by default, but
# this plugin's global Skill registration writes to its standard ~/.dsh/skills
# root. Re-enable the native provider so registered skills are indexed and
# available through ctx.skills; no upstream source or skill implementation is
# replaced.
- id: skill-filesystem
  disabled: false
- insert:
    - id: capability-menu-registry
      name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/registry'
    - id: capability-menu-search
      name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/search'
    - id: capability-menu-invoke
      name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/invoke'
    - id: capability-menu-policy
      name: '@daweifu/capability-menu/policy'
      config:
        # Native coding tools are cataloged under the reserved `built-in`
        # pseudo-server and are fully manageable like MCP tools. Unlisted
        # capabilities default to Resident; list them under `on-demand`/
        # `disabled` to pull MCP servers, native tools, or skills out of the
        # model surface. On-demand native tools stay invocable through
        # `meta_search` → `meta_invoke`. The `meta_search`/`meta_invoke`
        # control-plane tools and the reserved `run_code` transport never enter
        # the catalog. Do not name a real MCP server `built-in`.
        tools:
          resident:
            - bash
            - read
            - write
            - edit
            - read_image
            - glob
            - grep
    # Root entry: loads the package main, which mounts the Typert gateway that
    # exposes ctx.capabilityPolicy to the browser. Makes this package a loader
    # entry itself so @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules discovers its `dsh.client`
    # declaration and serves the 能力菜单 browser bundle (`./client`).
    - id: capability-menu
      name: '@daweifu/capability-menu'

readme.text:
dsh-capability-menu

统一管理 DeepSeek Harness 工具与技能，高效检索、按需调用，节省上下文
中文 · English

- [能力总览](#能力总览)
  - [能力模型](#能力模型)
  - [能力菜单](#能力菜单)
- [安装与卸载](#安装与卸载)
  - [从 npm 安装（推荐）](#从-npm-安装推荐)
  - [从源码安装](#从源码安装)
  - [验证安装](#验证安装)
  - [卸载](#卸载)
- [策略与目录](#策略与目录)
  - [能力暴露规则](#能力暴露规则)
  - [按需检索目录](#按需检索目录)
- [参与贡献](#参与贡献)

---

- 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 tools（包括 MCP 工具和内置工具）与 skills 建立统一能力目录：`ctx.capability`。
- 提供**常驻 / 按需 / 禁用**三档策略，管理能力的暴露与调用。
- 按需能力只在需要时提供给 Agent，减少单次请求携带的工具定义，节省 token 和上下文。

Capability 是本插件引入的上位概念：Tool / Skill 是不同类型的 capability。

| kind | 对 Agent 提供 | action | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tool` | 执行一个动作（MCP 工具或内置原生工具） | `execute` | 由 `ctx.tools` 索引 |
| `skill` | 某类任务的方法/流程/知识 | `load` | 由 `ctx.skills` 索引 |

模型获得两个元工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 对应 entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meta_search` | 搜索当前会话可用的按需能力；列表返回匹配总数、已返回数及是否截断，详情返回说明和工具参数 schema | `@daweifu/capability-menu/search` |
| `meta_invoke` | 统一执行面：Tool 真执行（走完整 `ctx.tools` 管线）+ Skill 加载；`force: true` 可重载已更新的 Skill | `@daweifu/capability-menu/invoke` |
安装后，在「设置」导航中选择「能力菜单」，即可管理 Tools 和 Skills。

| 操作 | 用法 |
| --- | --- |
| 更改档位 | 点击能力旁的圆点；也可以点击顶部档位计数，批量切换该组能力 |
| 查找能力 | 使用页签下方的过滤框搜索名称或分组；支持正则表达式，不区分大小写 |
| 查看能力详情 | 点击 Tool 查看定义；点击 Skill 展开文件列表并预览文件，内容按 Markdown 渲染 |
| 注册能力 | 点击右上角「注册能力」，添加 MCP 服务器或 Skill 目录；Skill 支持本机目录或公开 GitHub 链接 |
| 编辑或移除 | 在 Tools 的服务器分组或 Skills 的技能项中点击「编辑」 |
| 查看规则和按需目录 | 点击页头右侧的「策略与目录」，查看生效规则及按需能力摘要；可在按需检索目录中调整描述上限 |
| 编辑检索描述 | 将 Tool 或 Skill 设为「按需」后，点击旁边的「检索描述」，在来源描述的简短版本上修改 |

- **MCP 名称**：分组内省略 `mcp__服务器名__` 前缀；悬停可看全名，检索和调用仍用完整 ID。
- **注册位置**：MCP 写入 patch 配置（自动创建缺失的文件和目录）；请求头等凭据也保存在其中，请妥善保管。Skill 在所选技能根目录创建链接或导入目录。
- **GitHub Skill**：支持公开仓库的默认分支根目录（含 `SKILL.md`）、指定分支根目录 `.../tree/{branch}` 或其下的技能目录 `.../tree/{branch}/{skill-directory}`；也支持本机目录。导入需在运行 dsh 的机器上安装 Git；插件会校验 `SKILL.md`，只复制所选目录。
- **Skill 更新**：从 GitHub 导入的 Skill 会在打开菜单时检查更新，页面打开期间每小时再检查一次；也可在 Skills 页手动检查、查看差异并单个或批量更新。只比较导入的 Skill 目录；本地修改会阻止覆盖。本地软链和预设 Skill 不支持自动更新。

前置：[Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download)，以及已安装的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（确保终端中可运行 `dsh` 命令）。DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 要求 Node.js `>=24.9.0`。从 npm 安装无需单独安装 pnpm；从源码安装需要 pnpm。

插件 `0.1.9` 适配 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`，支持 Tool 三档分层和 `meta_invoke` 转发。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @daweifu/capability-menu
```

```sh
git clone https://github.com/PKUfudawei/dsh-capability-menu.git
cd dsh-capability-menu
pnpm install

```sh
cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web" && pnpm list @daweifu/capability-menu && dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -m1 '== @daweifu/capability-menu'
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @daweifu/capability-menu
```
这一章对应能力菜单中的「策略与目录」弹窗。

| 档位 | 能力 | 模型能看到什么 | 如何找到 | 如何使用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **常驻** | tool | 工具定义始终随请求提供 | 无需查找 | 直接调用；运行时经过完整 `ctx.tools` 管线 |
| | skill | 名称和简介显示在 `<available_skills>` 中 | 无需查找 | `skill` 工具按需加载正文 |
| **按需** | tool | 不随请求提供工具定义 | 用 `meta_search` 搜索候选项 | 按精确 ID 查看参数后，用 `meta_invoke` 调用 |
| | skill | 不显示在 `<available_skills>` 中 | 用 `meta_search` 搜索 | 用 `meta_invoke` 加载 `SKILL.md` |
| **禁用** | tool | 不随请求提供工具定义 | `meta_search` 中不可见 | 调用会被拒绝 |
| | skill | 不显示在 `<available_skills>` 中 | `meta_search` 中不可见 | 加载会被拒绝 |

适用范围与例外：

- MCP 工具和可编目的 DSH 原生工具都支持三档；原生工具归入 `built-in` 分组。请勿将 MCP 服务器命名为 `built-in`，以免与该分组冲突。
- `meta_search` 和 `meta_invoke` 默认常驻，不能在菜单中禁用。DSH Code Mode 的入口 `run_code` 不进入本插件的目录或菜单；手写通配规则仍可能匹配它，请勿将其设为按需或禁用。
- 高频工具建议保持常驻；按需工具可通过 `meta_search` 找 ID、查看参数 schema，再调用。
弹窗显示的是当前生效规则，由手写规则和菜单选择合成，并非另一份 YAML 文件。手写规则位于 `capability-menu-policy` entry 的 `config` 下。以下是配置片段；完整安装补丁见 [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml)。

- 默认 patch 是 `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/cordis.patch.yml`；Profile 也可在自己的 patch 中覆盖该 entry。
- 菜单中的档位调整立即生效，停手约 1.5 秒后写入 `stateFile`；检索描述和描述上限也保存在这里。这些写入不会触发 DSH 配置重载。手写规则仍是基础；界面选择覆盖同一能力的精确规则，禁用通配规则仍优先。
- `stateFile` 默认在 `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/capability-menu-policy.json`（默认 patch 的同目录），各 Profile 共用；需要隔离时，在 policy 和 registry 两个 entry 中指定同一个 `stateFile`。要清除界面选择，停止 DSH 后删除状态文件；原有 patch 规则仍会生效。

```yaml
config:
  tools:
    on-demand: # 按需
      - 'mcp__example__*'    # 某个 MCP 服务器下的工具

通常只需设置 `tools` 和 `skills`。文件路径与防抖等可选项使用默认值即可；完整参数见 [policy 配置](./src/policy.ts) 和 [registry 配置](./src/registry.ts)。

**规则优先级：** 按序匹配；禁用优先。在常驻与按需之间，精确规则优先于通配；同为精确或同为通配时，常驻优先。未命中任何规则则常驻。

| 优先级 | 规则 | 示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `disabled` 精确或通配 | `disabled: [forbidden_skill, 'mcp__secret__*']` |
| 2 | `resident` 精确 | `resident: [bash]` |
| 3 | `on-demand` 精确 | `on-demand: [example_skill]` |
| 4 | `resident` 通配 | `resident: ['mcp__gongfeng__*']` |
| 5 | `on-demand` 通配 | `on-demand: ['mcp__*']` |
| 默认 | 未命中任何规则 | — |

能力菜单点击档位会写入精确规则。若更高优先级规则覆盖了所选档位，界面会提示「分类未生效」。

`meta_search` 是 Agent 检索按需 Tool 和 Skill 的唯一入口。「策略与目录 → 按需检索目录」直接显示同一内存索引中的按需能力摘要，不生成单独的 YAML 文件。Agent 的检索结果还会按当前会话的可用范围过滤。

- **检索描述：** 按需能力默认使用来源描述的摘要（最多 320 字符），可在菜单中编辑。`meta_search` 的列表与关键词匹配使用该摘要；编辑不会修改来源定义。
- **描述上限：** 在「策略与目录 → 按需检索目录」设置，最小 20 字符。降低上限前需先缩短超限的自定义描述。
- **检索与调用：** 用 `meta_search({query})` 查找能力，再用 `meta_search({id, kind})` 查看参数，最后用 `meta_invoke({id, kind, args})` 调用或加载。已在当前会话加载的 Skill 可传 `force: true` 重新加载。
欢迎提交问题、文档修正和代码。贡献流程与合入标准见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)；issue 和 PR 可以使用中文或英文。

dsh-capability-menu

Manage DeepSeek Harness tools and skills, search efficiently, invoke on demand, and save context
中文 · English

- [Capability Overview](#capability-overview)
  - [Capability Model](#capability-model)
  - [Capability Menu](#capability-menu)
- [Installation and Uninstallation](#installation-and-uninstallation)
  - [Install from npm (recommended)](#install-from-npm-recommended)
  - [Install from source](#install-from-source)
  - [Verify the install](#verify-the-install)
  - [Uninstall](#uninstall)
- [Policy & catalog](#policy--catalog)
  - [Exposure rules](#exposure-rules)
  - [On-demand search catalog](#on-demand-search-catalog)
- [Contributing](#contributing)

- Builds a unified capability catalog (`ctx.capability`) for DeepSeek Harness tools (including MCP and built-in tools) and skills.
- Provides three policy tiers — **Resident / On-demand / Disabled** — to manage capability exposure and invocation.
- Supplies on-demand capabilities only when needed, reducing the tool definitions sent with each request and saving tokens and context.

*Capability* is the umbrella concept introduced by this plugin: a Tool and a Skill are different *kinds* of capability.

| kind | provides to the agent | action | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tool` | executes an action (an MCP tool or a harness-native built-in tool) | `execute` | indexed by `ctx.tools` |
| `skill` | the method / flow / knowledge for a class of tasks | `load` | indexed by `ctx.skills` |

The model gets two meta tools:

| tool | role | corresponding entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meta_search` | Search On-demand capabilities available to the current session; list mode reports total, returned, and whether results were truncated; detail returns descriptions and tool schemas | `@daweifu/capability-menu/search` |
| `meta_invoke` | Unified execution surface for Tools and Skills; pass `force: true` to reload updated Skill instructions | `@daweifu/capability-menu/invoke` |
After installation, open **Settings** and select **Capability Menu** from the settings navigation to manage Tools and Skills.

| Task | How to do it |
| --- | --- |
| Change a tier | Click the dot beside a capability. Click a tier count at the top to change the whole group. |
| Find a capability | Use the filter below the tabs to search by name or group. Regex is supported and matching is case-insensitive. |
| View details | Click a Tool to see its definition. Click a Skill to expand its files and preview them; content is rendered as Markdown. |
| Register a capability | Click **Register** in the top right to add an MCP server or Skill directory; Skills accept local paths or public GitHub URLs. |
| Edit or remove | Click **Edit** on a server group in Tools or a Skill row in Skills. |
| View rules and on-demand catalog | Click **Policy & catalog** on the right side of the page header. The catalog tab also sets the search description limit. |
| Edit search description | Set a Tool or Skill to **On-demand**, then click **Search description** beside it to edit a short version of the provider description. |

- **MCP names**: Server groups omit the `mcp__server__` prefix. Hover for the full name; search and invocation still use the full ID.
- **Registration**: MCP servers write to the patch config (missing files and directories are created). Request headers and other credentials are stored there; keep it secure. Skills are linked or imported into the selected skill root.
- **GitHub Skills**: Public repositories support a default-branch root (with `SKILL.md`), a branch root `.../tree/{branch}`, or a Skill directory `.../tree/{branch}/{skill-directory}`. Local paths also work. Git is required on the machine running dsh; the plugin validates `SKILL.md` and copies only the selected directory.
- **Skill updates:** GitHub-imported Skills are checked when the menu opens and hourly while it stays open. The Skills tab also lets you check manually, view diffs, and update one or several Skills. Checks cover only the imported Skill directory; local edits prevent replacement. Local links and preset Skills do not support automatic updates.

Prerequisites: [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download) and an installed [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with the `dsh` command available in your terminal. DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` requires Node.js `>=24.9.0`. Installing from npm needs no separate pnpm install; installing from source requires pnpm.

Plugin `0.1.9` supports DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` with full Tool tiering and `meta_invoke` forwarding.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @daweifu/capability-menu
```

```sh
git clone https://github.com/PKUfudawei/dsh-capability-menu.git
cd dsh-capability-menu
pnpm install

```sh
cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web" && pnpm list @daweifu/capability-menu && dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -m1 '== @daweifu/capability-menu'
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @daweifu/capability-menu
```
This chapter follows the **Policy & catalog** dialog in Capability Menu.
All capabilities (Tool and Skill) fall into three tiers by their **exposure level** (what the model sees in the context) and their **execution mode**:

| tier | capability | what the model sees | how to find it | how to use it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Resident** | tool | Tool definition is included with every request | No search needed | Call directly; it goes through the full `ctx.tools` pipeline |
| | skill | Name and summary appear in `<available_skills>` | No search needed | The `skill` tool loads the content when needed |
| **On-demand** | tool | Tool definition is not included with requests | Search candidates with `meta_search` | Inspect parameters by exact ID, then call with `meta_invoke` |
| | skill | Not shown in `<available_skills>` | Search with `meta_search` | Load `SKILL.md` with `meta_invoke` |
| **Disabled** | tool | Tool definition is not included with requests | Hidden from `meta_search` | Calls are rejected |
| | skill | Not shown in `<available_skills>` | Hidden from `meta_search` | Loads are rejected |

- MCP tools and cataloged DSH native tools support all three tiers; native tools appear in the `built-in` group. Do not name an MCP server `built-in`, which would collide with that group.
- `meta_search` and `meta_invoke` are Resident by default and cannot be disabled in the menu. Code Mode's entry tool `run_code` does not appear in this plugin's catalog or menu; handwritten wildcard rules can still match it, so do not set it to On-demand or Disabled.
- Keep frequently used tools Resident; use `meta_search` to find an On-demand tool's ID and inspect its schema before invocation.

The dialog shows effective rules composed from hand-written rules and menu choices; it is not another YAML file. Hand-written rules belong under `config` in the `capability-menu-policy` entry. This is a config fragment; see [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml) for the complete installation patch.

- The default patch is `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/cordis.patch.yml`. A profile can override the entry in its own patch.
- Tier changes in Capability Menu apply immediately and are written to `stateFile` about 1.5 seconds after input stops; search descriptions and their length limit are stored there too. These writes do not trigger DSH config reloads. Patch rules remain the base; UI choices override exact rules for the same capability, while Disabled wildcards still take priority.
- `stateFile` defaults to `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/capability-menu-policy.json` (beside the default patch), so profiles share UI choices. To isolate profiles, set the same custom `stateFile` in both the policy and registry entries. To clear UI choices, stop DSH and delete the state file; patch rules remain in effect.

```yaml
config:
  tools:
    on-demand: # On-demand
      - 'mcp__example__*'    # tools from one MCP server

Usually, you only need `tools` and `skills`. The optional file paths and debounce settings can keep their defaults. For every parameter, see the [policy config](./src/policy.ts) and [registry config](./src/registry.ts).

**Rule priority:** Rules are checked in order; Disabled takes precedence. Between Resident and On-demand, exact rules beat wildcards; at the same specificity, Resident wins. Capabilities matching no rule are Resident.

| priority | rule | example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `disabled` exact or wildcard | `disabled: [forbidden_skill, 'mcp__secret__*']` |
| 2 | `resident` exact | `resident: [bash]` |
| 3 | `on-demand` exact | `on-demand: [example_skill]` |
| 4 | `resident` wildcard | `resident: ['mcp__gongfeng__*']` |
| 5 | `on-demand` wildcard | `on-demand: ['mcp__*']` |
| default | no rule matched | — |
Selecting a tier in Capability Menu writes an exact rule. If a higher-priority rule overrides the selected tier, the UI reports that the classification did not apply.

`meta_search` is the Agent's only search entry for On-demand Tools and Skills. **Policy & catalog → On-demand search catalog** shows summaries from the same in-memory index without generating a separate YAML file. Agent results are also filtered to capabilities available in the current session.

- **Search description:** On-demand capabilities use a short provider description (up to 320 characters) by default; you can edit it in the menu. `meta_search` uses this summary for its list and keyword matching. Editing it does not change the provider definition.
- **Description limit:** Set it under **Policy & catalog → On-demand search catalog** (minimum 20 characters). Shorten custom descriptions that exceed a lower limit before saving it.
- **Search and invoke:** Use `meta_search({query})` to find a capability, `meta_search({id, kind})` to inspect its parameters, and `meta_invoke({id, kind, args})` to call or load it. Pass `force: true` to reload a Skill already loaded in the current session.
